newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 22.

text.p: -- Applied Materials Inc shares fell 1-1/8 to 30-7/8 in after-hours trading after the company posted fourth quarter profits of $0.40 per share, including a charge of $0.09. A year earlier it earned $0.84 per share.
The supplier of equipment used in making semiconductors said it expected the industry-wide downturn to continue into early 1997.
-- Valero Energy Corp said it is seeking a merger partner for its natural gas unit in a deal that could be worth more than $1.4 billion. Shares closed up 1/8 to 25.

-- Crown Crafts Inc is recalling from retailers all furniture products made by its Hans Benjamin unit and expects a pretax charge of $1.9-$2.5 million. It has suspended shipments from the unit pending an internal investigation of some labeling issues.

-- A group including RMS Ltd, Crystal Diamond Inc and investor Roy Speer said Thursday it had cut its stake in Silver King Communications Inc to about 10.2 percent, or 763,095 shares. The group sold 107,732 shares, according to a regulatory filing. Silver King closed at 24-3/4.
